heading: Wednesday, July 30, 2025
topLine: Physics-tailored neural network uncovers non-reciprocal force laws in dusty plasma. Also: Mistral releases Codestral 25.08 and enterprise coding stack.

items.headline: Physics-tailored neural network uncovers non-reciprocal force laws in dusty plasma
items.summary: Emory physicists (Wentao Yu, Eslam Abdelaleem, Ilya Nemenman, Justin Burton) trained a symmetry-aware neural network on 3D particle tracking in laboratory dusty plasma and recovered the interparticle forces to better than 99% accuracy, showing that a leading particle attracts a trailing one while the trailing one repels it, and that long-held assumptions about charge scaling with particle radius and size-independent force decay are wrong. Published in PNAS and later awarded a PNAS Cozzarelli Prize.

items.headline: Mistral releases Codestral 25.08 and enterprise coding stack
items.summary: Codestral 25.08 is an update to Mistral's fill-in-the-middle code completion model, announced with an enterprise coding stack that includes Codestral Embed, Devstral and the Mistral Code IDE extension. Mistral reports 30% more accepted completions and 50% fewer runaway generations than the prior version.
